## Change

What does this feature do? Which app owns it?

## Checks

- [ ] Ran `npm run check` in each affected app.
- [ ] If contracts changed, updated affected examples/consumers and checked both apps.
- [ ] Kept changes and dependencies within the appropriate app.
- [ ] No secrets or private financial data included.

## Integration notes

List changed API fields, new environment variable names (not values), migrations, or anything the other team needs to know. Mark mocked or unimplemented functionality explicitly.
